subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】January 一月; February 二月; March 三月; April 四月; May 五月; June 六月; July 七月; August 八月; September 九月; October 十月; November 十一月; December 十二月; contest 比赛; trip 旅行; holiday 假日
【重点句型】When is ...? ……在什么时候？ It's in ... 在……月。 We have ... 我们有…… Happy ...! ……快乐！ When is the trip? 旅行在什么时候？
【A Let's talk】Zhang Peng: When is Tree Planting Day? Amy: It's in March. Zhang Peng: When is the sports meet? Amy: It's in April. Zhang Peng: We have a school trip in May.
【Read and write】There are twelve months in a year. New Year's Day is in January. Tree Planting Day is in March. Labour Day is in May. Children's Day is in June. Teachers' Day is in September. We have a party in December.
key_points: When is the trip? 旅行在什么时候？
